1. Install the package mlbench and use the follows to import the data

```{r}
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("C:\\Users\\student\\Downloads\\PimaIndiansDiabetes.csv")
head(df)
```

```{r}
# Cleaning
df <- df |> rename(target = diabetes)

colSums(is.na(df))
```

```{r}
# Split Data into Training and Testing
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)

df_train <- df[ splitIndex,]
df_test <- df[-splitIndex,]
```


Train and Test a decision tree and a random forest with caret. Plot the variable importance of these models. 

```{r}
# Decision Tree
test_target_factor <- factor(df_test$target, levels = c("neg", "pos"))


dt <- train(target~., data = df_train, method = "rpart2", maxdepth = 3)
pred <- predict(dt, df_test)

cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = test_target_factor, positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```


```{r}
# Plot DT Importance
plot(varImp(dt))
```


```{r}
# Random Forest
rf <- train(target~., data = df_train, method = "rf", ntree = 1000)
pred <- predict(rf, df_test)


cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = test_target_factor, positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```


```{r}
# Plot RF Importance
plot(varImp(rf))
```


2. Train and Test a `glmnet` model. Plot the variable importance of the model. 

```{r}
# `glmnet` model
library(glmnet)

glmnet <- train(target~., data = df_train, method = "glmnet")
pred <- predict(glmnet, df_test)

cm = confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = test_target_factor, positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```


```{r}
# Plot Importance
plot(varImp(glmnet))
```


3. Train and test two models that are not `ranger`, `glmnet` or `rpart`  with caret. If possible, plot the variable importance of the model. 

```{r}
# Model 1: `ada`
library(fastAdaboost)

ada <- train(target~., data = df_train, method = "adaboost", iter = 10)
pred <- predict(ada, df_test)

cm = confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = test_target_factor, positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```


```{r}
# Plot Importance
plot(varImp(ada))
```


```{r}
# Model 2: `xgbTree`
library(xgboost)
df_train$target <- factor(df_train$target, 
                          levels = c(0, 1), 
                          labels = c("neg", "pos"))

xgb <- train(target~., data = df_train, method = "xgbTree", nrounds = 50)
pred <- predict(xgb, df_test)

cm = confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = test_target_factor, positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```


```{r}
# Plot Importance
plot(varImp(xgb))
```
